note: Clearing the 9 remaining `_assign_` definitions in the stock family: 6 in addons/stock (stock_move._assign_picking/_assign_picking_values/_assign_picking_post_process/_assign_reserved_bypass/_assign_reserved_with_stock, stock_quant._assign_next_inventory_date) plus their 3 overrides in sale_stock, sale_project_stock and stock_picking_batch. Per §2.4 Mutation, `_assign_` -> `_update_`, with two named by the rules that outrank the bare verb swap: _assign_picking_values returns a dict that feeds picking.write(), so it is _prepare_picking_values under the _get_/_prepare_ discriminator, and the empty post-hook became _post_process_picking to match the model's existing _post_process_created_moves rather than read as a mutation it is not. addons/stock now has zero abolished-verb definitions. No consumer outside odoo/addons: enterprise, agromarin and design-themes were grepped and hold none.
